name: Bloxr Survival
description:
BLOXR — FREE-TO-PLAY JAVA + BEDROCK SURVIVAL

Build a home worth coming back to. Find your spot, protect your land and make progress with friends in a growing Survival community.

FREE TO JOIN. FREE TO PLAY.

No joining fee, subscription or purchase is needed to play on Bloxr. Website registration and linking are free too. Optional shop purchases are available, but buying something is not required to join or play.

YOUR MINECRAFT ACCOUNT STAYS YOURS

Linking connects your Minecraft name on Bloxr to your separate player dashboard. It uses a Bloxr in-game verification code; it does not change your Microsoft/Minecraft account, password, game licence or ownership, and it does not give us access to your Microsoft account.

We NEVER ask for your Microsoft/Minecraft password or recovery codes. If you register on bloxr.co.uk, create a separate Bloxr website password — use a different password from your Microsoft account. Follow the in-game /link instructions and keep your private Bloxr link code to yourself.

MORE TO DO THAN JUST SURVIVE

- Protect your builds with land claims and choose which friends can build or use containers.

- Take quests, develop skills and earn Bloxr coins through jobs and eligible gameplay.

- Buy and sell supplies in the server shop, list your own items in the Auction House, or pay other players to fulfil your material orders.

- Link free for 100 Bloxr coins and a welcome prize-wheel spin. Earn more spins through active Survival play; win coins, supplies, gold armour and rarer prizes such as diamonds.

- Compare skill levels and survival records, including longest survival without dying.

- Use a GravesX compass to find your items after death. Graves can be looted by other players, so head back promptly. PvP is enabled.

- See your linked balance, skills, quests and recent activity on the website. Add friends, message privately and optionally enable Bloxr phone-app notifications.
